description: This file exports constants and modules related to a diagram rendering component, specifically for git graph visualization. It defines graph data structures, rendering logic, styling, and methods to manipulate git branch and commit data, indicating that it is part of a visualization or diagram generation library.

methods.name: w.commit
methods.description: Adds a new commit to the current branch with specified details.

methods.name: w.branch
methods.description: Creates a new branch with a given name, starting at the current head.

methods.name: w.merge
methods.description: Merges another branch into the current branch, with optional custom type and ID.

methods.name: w.cherryPick
methods.description: Creates a cherry-pick commit from a specified source commit into the current branch.

methods.name: w.checkout
methods.description: Switches the current branch to the specified branch.

methods.name: w.prettyPrint
methods.description: Outputs a readable version of the current commit graph.

methods.name: w.clear
methods.description: Resets the commit graph and branch data.

methods.name: w.getBranchesAsObjArray
methods.description: Returns an array of branch objects with their names.

methods.name: w.getBranches
methods.description: Returns current branch data.

methods.name: w.getCommits
methods.description: Returns the current commits as an object.

methods.name: w.getCommitsArray
methods.description: Returns an array of all commits.

methods.name: w.getCurrentBranch
methods.description: Returns the name of the current branch.

methods.name: w.getDirection
methods.description: Returns the diagram direction (e.g., 'LR' or 'TB').

methods.name: w.getHead
methods.description: Returns the current head commit.

methods.name: w.setAccTitle
methods.description: Sets the accessibility title for the diagram.

methods.name: w.getAccTitle
methods.description: Gets the accessibility title.

methods.name: w.getAccDescription
methods.description: Gets the accessibility description.

methods.name: w.setAccDescription
methods.description: Sets the accessibility description.

methods.name: w.setDiagramTitle
methods.description: Sets the diagram title.

methods.name: w.getDiagramTitle
methods.description: Gets the diagram title.
